Hi Helium D. team,
I'm Nick from VIMU (www.vimu.io), a Shenzhen manufacturer of Bitcoin solo miners and miner control boards since 2023.
We design and build the BV002 (10 TH/s, BM1373) and the BV003 Hydro (20 TH/s). We also manufacture NerdQAXE++ and NerdOCTAXE home miners.
If you would like to look at wholesale supply for your shop, please share your WhatsApp number so our sales team can contact you with the details.
Best regards,
Nick / VIMU
www.vimu.io
(email hidden)
Handed to the team · Supplier and wholesale partnership decisions need a person. No phone or WhatsApp

Hi Nick,

Thanks for getting in touch and for the overview of VIMU's lineup.

Supplier and wholesale decisions are made by our team, so I've passed your message on to them with the models you listed. We don't share a WhatsApp number in reply to an introduction like this. If there's interest, someone from the team will reply in this thread.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
